evacuation_route_waypoints.instruction: Start at Bayanan Baywalk Lakeshore assembly marker and head west on Bayanan Road.
Continue straight past Purok 2 junction staying on elevated sidewalk.
Pass Barangay Bayanan Hall and proceed toward National Road.
Enter Bayanan Elementary School Main gate on National Road.
Assemble at Purok 3 coastal marker and move southwest away from shoreline.
Turn right onto Bayanan Interior Road toward the barangay complex.
Arrive at Barangay Bayanan Multi-Purpose Covered Court.
Depart Purok 6 North Compound heading west.
Follow Purok 4 street sign toward Unit I school campus.
Arrive at Bayanan Elementary School Unit I.
